## IPublishSarifReviewOptions.ignoreApprovalHold property

Publish despite an approval hold declared in the SARIF (`properties.sarifToComment.approval: "awaiting-approval"`<!-- -->). Bypasses only the hold, never validation, and is not part of the publication identity.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly ignoreApprovalHold?: boolean | undefined;
```
